blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A three-day synchronized crackdown against illegal weapons across Cebu City yielded 27 unlicensed firearms and led to the arrest of 21 individuals. This was according to the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) in its intensified campaign aimed at loose firearms or those lacking proper documentation and legal authorization. The crackdown was conducted from Nov. 12 to 14. The campaign, where firearms were confiscated included buy-busts operations and tips given by concerned citizens.
